name: pi-codemode-guard
description: Pi extension that compiles LLM-written codemode scripts into pi's codemode syntax: tolerant argument shapes, markdown fences, @options/@exec pragmas, IIFE wrappers, JSON tool-call programs, missing await, bare tool calls, and the OpenCode / Cloudflare age
